name: r5-contact-control-on
description: THE CONTACT CONTROL PAIR, arm 2 of 2 — `noDamage: FALSE`, one field apart from `r5-contact-control-off`. THE POSITIVE CONTROL that arms every contact-freedom negative R5 makes. Same boot, same level, same held RIGHT, same 80 ticks: the player walks into `sandtrap@96,128` and the game does what the guard was hiding — `hits += 1`, `hitsTimer = 20` (twenty ticks with the four arrow branches skipped, `Player.as:1506`), `Game.shake += 5`, and `knockback(3, ...)` writing velocity AWAY from the trap. So the stream must DIVERGE from the contact-free model, and it must diverge at the tick the model predicts the boxes meet. A negative that cannot be made to fail is not evidence; this is what makes 'R5's walk never touched anything' a claim.
